objective: Measure and bound stale-universe bias with the free Massive history window before purchasing deeper history or changing any model.

method.liquidity_measure: mean(close * max(volume, 0)) over 20 complete past-and-current trading dates
method.conservative_candidate_definition: Massive active common stock, absent from the stored Robinhood source on the anchor date, inside the all-security top-1000 liquidity rank
method.sensitivity_definition: Massive active common stock, absent from the stored Robinhood source, inside the common-stock-only top-1000 liquidity rank

interpretation.confirmed: The stored Robinhood symbol population is stale in both directions: it can omit historical exits and also liquid entrants, spin-offs, renamed securities, and newer listings.
interpretation.materiality: After reproducing the model's exact point-in-time liquidity rule, 90 to 94 missing common stocks remain per anchor and 59 stable entities persist across both anchors.
interpretation.not_yet_confirmed: Candidate membership alone does not establish corrected delisting returns, corporate-action continuity, or improvement in out-of-sample model metrics.

data_quality_findings: Massive grouped responses contained two duplicate ticker rows per sampled trading date; deterministic ticker-date deduplication is required before feature construction.
Massive reference snapshots contained two duplicate ticker keys at each final anchor; stable identifiers and explicit collision reporting are required.
Ticker strings are insufficient join keys for entrants, spin-offs, mergers, and symbol changes.

decision.next_gate: Backfill candidate prices and listing/corporate-action lineage, build daily point-in-time membership, then run a leakage-safe source-ablation comparison before model adoption.

remaining_limitations: The free Massive plan covers only the recent two-year window and cannot repair the full five-year history.
Only two anchors have exact 20-date liquidity rankings; daily membership is not yet materialized.
Historical exits and delisting returns are not yet included.
Provider-only candidates must pass identifier continuity and corporate-action review before price joins.
No evidence yet shows that the repaired universe improves calibrated out-of-sample predictions or net returns.
